subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: Sorry, my Portuguese is still basic.
portuguese: Desculpe, o meu português ainda é básico.
pronunciationNote: desh-KOOL-p oo may-oo poor-too-GAYSH EEN-dah eh BAH-zee-koo
notes: A polite way to set expectations.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Desculpe, o meu português ainda é básico, mas quero tentar.
exampleSentences.english: Sorry, my Portuguese is still basic, but I want to try.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: Can you say that in another way?
portuguese: Pode dizer isso de outra forma?
pronunciationNote: POD dee-ZER EE-soo duh OH-trah FOR-mah
notes: Useful when repeating is not enough.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não percebi. Pode dizer isso de outra forma?
exampleSentences.english: I did not understand. Can you say that in another way?

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: Can you give me an example?
notes: A practical phrase for understanding explanations.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Pode dar-me um exemplo simples?
exampleSentences.english: Can you give me a simple example?

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: I understand the word, but not the sentence.
portuguese: Percebo a palavra, mas não a frase.
pronunciationNote: pair-SEH-boo ah pah-LAH-vrah mash nawng ah FRAH-zuh
notes: A simple way to be specific about the problem.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Percebo a palavra, mas não a frase toda.
exampleSentences.english: I understand the word, but not the whole sentence.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
notes: A useful short response after an explanation.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Percebi a maior parte, obrigado.
exampleSentences.english: I understood most of it, thank you.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
notes: Apanhar can mean catch in the sense of understanding.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Desculpe, não apanhei a última parte.
exampleSentences.english: Sorry, I missed the last part.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: Can I try to say it?
notes: Useful for active practice in conversation.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Posso tentar dizer em português?
exampleSentences.english: Can I try to say it in Portuguese?

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
notes: A simple way to signal effort before speaking.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Vou tentar em português. Corrija-me, por favor.
exampleSentences.english: I will try in Portuguese. Correct me, please.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
notes: Good for asking for feedback while learning.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se eu errar, pode corrigir-me?
exampleSentences.english: If I make a mistake, can you correct me?

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
notes: A direct check after trying a phrase.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Disse isso corretamente em português?
exampleSentences.english: Did I say that correctly in Portuguese?

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: I am not sure how to say it.
portuguese: Não tenho a certeza de como dizer.
pronunciationNote: nawng TEN-yoo ah sir-TEH-zah duh KOH-moo dee-ZER
notes: A simple bridge when you lack a word or structure.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não tenho a certeza de como dizer isto.
exampleSentences.english: I am not sure how to say this.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: I know the word in English.
notes: Useful when switching or asking for help with vocabulary.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Sei a palavra em inglês, mas não em português.
exampleSentences.english: I know the word in English, but not in Portuguese.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: Can I say it in English?
notes: A practical fallback when communication matters more than practice.

exampleSentences.portuguese: É difícil em português. Posso dizer em inglês?
exampleSentences.english: It is difficult in Portuguese. Can I say it in English?

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
notes: Useful when someone switches to English and you want practice.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se não se importa, podemos falar em português?
exampleSentences.english: If you do not mind, can we speak in Portuguese?

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
notes: A slightly fuller version for keeping the conversation in Portuguese.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Podemos continuar em português? Quero praticar.
exampleSentences.english: Can we continue in Portuguese? I want to practise.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
notes: A short polite phrase before asking something.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Desculpe interromper, posso fazer uma pergunta?
exampleSentences.english: Sorry to interrupt, can I ask a question?

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
notes: Useful when joining a conversation politely.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Posso acrescentar uma coisa pequena?
exampleSentences.english: Can I add one small thing?

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
notes: A direct way to agree.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Concordo com isso.
exampleSentences.english: I agree with that.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
notes: Direct but clear; soften it with desculpe if needed.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Desculpe, não concordo com isso.
exampleSentences.english: Sorry, I do not agree with that.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
notes: Consigo is a polite/formal way to say with you.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Concordo consigo nessa parte.
exampleSentences.english: I agree with you on that part.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
notes: A natural response when an explanation is clear.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Agora percebo. Isso faz sentido.
exampleSentences.english: Now I understand. That makes sense.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
notes: A simple way to keep the conversation going.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Isso é interessante. Pode explicar melhor?
exampleSentences.english: That is interesting. Can you explain more?

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
notes: A short prompt to keep someone talking.

exampleSentences.portuguese: E depois? O que aconteceu?
exampleSentences.english: And then? What happened?

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
notes: A simple follow-up question for stories or problems.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não percebi. O que aconteceu?
exampleSentences.english: I did not understand. What happened?

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
notes: Polite formal question for asking someone's view.

exampleSentences.portuguese: O que acha desta ideia?
exampleSentences.english: What do you think of this idea?

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
notes: A basic way to introduce your view.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Na minha opinião, é uma boa ideia.
exampleSentences.english: In my opinion, it is a good idea.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
notes: Useful for extending a conversation politely.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Tenho outra pergunta, se não se importa.
exampleSentences.english: I have another question, if you do not mind.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: Can I ask one more thing?
notes: A polite phrase before a final question.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Posso perguntar mais uma coisa antes de ir?
exampleSentences.english: Can I ask one more thing before I go?

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
notes: A simple way to end a conversation.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Tenho de ir agora, mas falamos depois.
exampleSentences.english: I have to go now, but we will talk later.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
notes: A friendly way to pause a conversation.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Agora não posso. Podemos falar mais tarde?
exampleSentences.english: I cannot now. Can we talk later?
